profile_text.body:
SpaceX is a for-profit company founded in 2002 and headquartered in Hawthorne, California. Its website describes it as designing, manufacturing and launching advanced rockets and spacecraft, and says it was founded to revolutionize space technology with the ultimate goal of enabling people to live on other planets. The same description of designing, manufacturing and launching advanced rockets and spacecraft is repeated on the site.

The company's AI position is not described in the material available. No products are tracked for SpaceX, and no lawsuits or MCP servers are listed. Its legal exposure is recorded in California, with a count of 281.
